about: Settings every profile shares unless the profile holds the same key (null: that part is not managed). Not a profile itself. features: repository fields merged into the profile's `repo` (per repository: [settings] features = { has_wiki = true }). security: features the tool turns on (a false, here or in [settings] security = { ... }, leaves that feature alone; nothing is ever turned off); a private repository on the free plan skips secret scanning, push protection, private vulnerability reporting and CodeQL (reported unsupported), and a repository whose own workflow runs CodeQL (advanced setup) keeps it. actions: the Actions policy; selected_actions.patterns_allowed lists every third-party owner/repo the org's workflows use (scanned 2026-11-10, hadolint added with ns3-containers#72, over every repository's .github/workflows and .github/actions), and plan refuses a repository whose workflows use one not covered. tag_ruleset: the `release-tags` ruleset (deletion, force-push and update of v* tags blocked; creation is not restricted, since the release workflows push tags with GITHUB_TOKEN, which cannot be a ruleset bypass actor). release_environment: the `release` environment with required reviewers, created only where enabled (per repository: [settings] release_environment = true).
